text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as expected of Helios-san,
that was a fantastic race!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! You're right, my vibes were
seriously off the charts today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Vibes, huh!
Maybe that's what I've been missing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
what even are "vibes"?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so like, super hyped and going all out?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"This looks like it'll be well worth
kneading and experimenting with!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aha!
Then I'll master going all-out blazing front-runner to the max!
Then let's do it again! Deal!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
I'm definitely going to win next time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hehe!
Well, thanks for today, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad
I got to run with you today, Helios-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She was like that in the paddock too, but
she's so full of energy in the gate and during the race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I was the one getting energized.
What an incredible Umamusume she was.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Speak of the devil, here comes Helios-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "We're having a mega-hype vibe fest today, wanna come, Tannhauser?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I feel like this... brings us one step
closer to solving the mystery of vibes!
